name: github-project-galaxy-api
description: Turn a GitHub user's public repositories into an embeddable galaxy map, JSON graph API, and interactive viewer.

scripts.check:pages: node --check scripts/github.mjs && node --check scripts/graph.mjs && node --check scripts/svg.mjs && node --check scripts/build.mjs && node --check scripts/pages-app.mjs && node --check scripts/build-public-pages.mjs && node --check scripts/public-home.js && node --check scripts/public-viewer.js
scripts.validate:pages: npm run build:pages && html-validate site/index.html site/u/index.html && eslint site/app.js site/viewer.js && node scripts/validate-pages.mjs
scripts.validate: npm run validate:pages && npm run validate:actions
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run check:worker && npm run check:action && npm run check:pages && npm test && npm run validate
